physical_subject: How can a computer locate a brightness boundary using only local arithmetic?
relationship: The valid stride-one filter [-1,+1] returns signed neighboring intensity differences, shifts its response with an interior translated edge, and cancels equal additive offsets.
operation: Carry a row of the same image into neighbor subtraction, reuse signed weights, shift the strip and add a common brightness offset.
closest_prior: Sliding-window algorithm, dot products, JPEG compression and broad neural-network introduction
substantive_difference: A signed local finite-difference filter, its translated response and cancellation of an additive offset; not sliding-window sum optimization, vector alignment, frequency compression or a complete neural network.
